summary: Bioforce Nanosciences Holdings filed an 8-K reporting the receipt of an assignment of federal oil and gas leases covering ~19,957 acres in Nye County, Nevada from Natural Minerals Trust, LLC (controlled by majority shareholder Nexus Capital). The assignment is pending BLM approval; no deal price, stake, or premium is stated. If approved, Bioforce intends to develop the leases, with primary terms of 10 years and a 12.5% royalty. This is a non-routine operational update but does not fit standard special-situation categories like acquisitions or divestitures; it is more akin to an asset assignment subject to regulatory approval. Watch for BLM action and any subsequent partnership announcements.
